content: 'Inter Display' is NOT a separate family listed on fonts.google.com (only 'Inter' is listed) and is NOT packaged separately by Fontsource (@fontsource/inter and @fontsource/inter-tight exist; no @fontsource/inter-display package exists on npm -- confirmed 404 on registry). 'Inter Display' is real: as of Inter v4.0 (rsms/inter GitHub releases, OFL-1.1 license), the variable font's opsz (optical size) axis at opsz=32 produces six 'Display' cuts, also shipped as separate static woff2 files under the second family name 'Inter Display' in the official release archive (rsms/inter, latest v4.1, Nov 2024). To use true Inter Display, must manually download the official static woff2 files from the rsms/inter GitHub release and self-host via next/font/local -- no npm package or next/font/google shortcut exists for it. Regular 'Inter' is available zero-config via next/font/google (auto self-hosted).
